current_milestone.title: Authorize and execute the controlled primary experiment
current_milestone.outcome: The primary package is owner-signed, both experiment packages and the executor are frozen; complete rotated-key confirmation, one synthetic provider calibration, and formal execution without premature Final Test access.

commands.command: git push to pocketvin/researchforge and verify remote main through the GitHub API
commands.summary: The public repository was created and main matched local commit 804ddcb9832113427fd41a703801be2cb0f6c27a. Secret/PDF scans passed; the temporary repository-scoped SSH credential was removed locally and from GitHub. CI run 33502340783 passed backend, frontend/Playwright and container jobs.

commands.command: uv lock --check && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy --strict src scripts tests migrations && uv run pytest -q && uv run python scripts/validate_contracts.py && git diff --check && docker compose config --quiet
commands.summary: The updated full local gate passed: 69 locked packages, 117 formatted files, clean lint and strict typing across 73 source files, 153 tests, 85 required contract files, diff whitespace and Compose configuration.

commands.command: uv run pytest -q tests/application/test_calibration.py tests/application/test_formal_experiment.py tests/domain/test_contingency_benchmark.py tests/application/test_simulated_usability.py && env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u RESEARCHFORGE_ROTATED_KEY_CONFIRMED uv run researchforge calibration-preflight && env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u RESEARCHFORGE_ROTATED_KEY_CONFIRMED uv run researchforge evolution-preflight
commands.summary: Calibration, formal, sealed-contingency, and simulation controls passed, including a 144-run synthetic full path. Both real preflights contacted no provider; calibration blocked only on rotated-key confirmation, while formal execution additionally blocked on owner signoff and the missing derived calibration artifact.

commands.command: uv run pytest -q tests/domain/test_primary_benchmark.py && uv run python scripts/validate_contracts.py
commands.summary: Five primary-package regressions passed. The contract validator accepted 24 sources, 144 facts, 24 explicitly synthetic chunks, 24 frozen cases, split isolation, cutoffs, references, artifact hashes and package hash stability.

commands.command: uv lock --check && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy --strict src scripts tests migrations && uv run pytest -q && uv run python scripts/validate_contracts.py && git diff --check && docker compose config --quiet
commands.summary: The full local gate passed: 68 locked packages, 98 formatted files, clean lint and strict typing across 60 source files, 132 tests, all current/historical contract checks, Markdown links, diff whitespace and Compose configuration.

commands.command: uv run ruff format src tests && uv run ruff check src tests && uv run mypy --strict src tests && uv run pytest -q tests/adapters/test_evolution_storage.py tests/application/test_evolution.py tests/api/test_api.py tests/test_cli_runtime.py
commands.summary: Formatting, lint, strict typing and 16 focused Evolution storage, policy, CLI and API tests passed. Synthetic policy outcomes remain explicitly non-formal.

commands.command: uv run pytest -q tests/application/test_modes.py tests/application/test_reliability.py && uv run python scripts/run_reliability_batch.py
commands.summary: Five success cases, five cutoff-driven missing-data cases and the fixed batch passed; 20/20 runs succeeded with four runs per mode and zero provider calls.

commands.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH=<local-chrome> npm run test:e2e
commands.summary: Frontend typecheck, lint, three unit tests, production build and Playwright E2E passed; axe found no critical-impact violations on Research or Skill Lab.

commands.command: docker compose build && docker compose up -d --wait && uv run python scripts/docker_smoke.py && docker compose exec -T api sh -c 'alembic downgrade base && alembic upgrade head'
commands.summary: The PostgreSQL/API/frontend stack built and became healthy; a frontend-proxied run persisted six facts and a ten-stage Trace, and migration down/up passed. Compatible Public ECR image overrides were used because Docker Hub authentication timed out.

commands.command: swift scripts/build_demo_video.swift && browser interaction over http://127.0.0.1:4173
commands.summary: Research and Skill Lab were visually and interactively verified with no console warnings/errors; two public-fixture PNGs and a 12-second 1280x720 H.264 preview were produced.

next_action.title: Confirm a rotated local key and run calibration
next_action.why: Both frozen packages, owner authorization, the controlled executor, Docker runtime, demo, simulation harness, and synthetic calibration gate are ready; a safe local provider credential is the remaining external pre-call control.
next_action.first_step: Place a newly rotated key only in the created ignored .env, set RESEARCHFORGE_ROTATED_KEY_CONFIRMED=1, then run the one-request synthetic calibration.
acceptance_evidence: All 24 prepared cases retain stable IDs, official source links, publication cutoffs, hashes, required facts and expected deterministic calculations.
Evolution, Validation and Final Test company/group keys have zero overlap and the suite hash is stable across three repetitions.
Redistribution status is explicit and unsafe original text is replaced by synthetic evidence in the public package.
The owner signed package 3638eb1ca7b8192cb6a901f4b0d51c8373ccaff1e776758605f1d4b975cb1c3f at 2026-09-01T19:14:33+08:00 before any formal provider run.
A rotated key is available only in ignored local configuration with RESEARCHFORGE_ROTATED_KEY_CONFIRMED=1.
Calibration preflight remains provider_contacted=false until the rotated-key control passes.
Formal preflight additionally requires the pinned synthetic calibration artifact to pass.

blockers.description: A rotated OpenAI key is required for live calibration; the previously exposed key is prohibited.
blockers.owner_action: Provide the rotated key only through the ignored local environment when the offline preflight is ready.

last_session.summary: Recorded the owner's unified primary-package signoff, created the ignored local .env, and published the verified code to public GitHub; rotated key and live calibration/experiment/simulations remain.
